en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing ornate spa buildings and a covered colonnade set in landscaped gardens with flowerbeds and walking paths. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll in the foreground. In the background, wooded hills and additional buildings are visible. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the scene as Karlsbad's Wandelhalle, Militär‑Badehaus and Neubad, with a small publisher credit.
